high_level_description: The image is a meme that combines two distinct elements to create a humorous effect. The top part of the meme features a text-based statement and two toy dinosaurs. The text reads: "If plastic is made out of petroleum, and petroleum is made out of fossils and fossils are dinosaurs, then plastic dinosaurs are real dinosaurs." Below the text, there are two toy dinosaurs, one orange with wings and another green with a spiky back. The bottom part of the meme shows a scene from a movie where a character is speaking.
